module_title: PM eVIDYA, The 4 Quadrants of MOOCs & NISHTHA Integration
introduction: This intermediate tier transitions into the structural consolidation of these platforms under the PM eVIDYA scheme (launched during COVID-19). It also details the pedagogical design of MOOCs (The 4 Quadrants) and the integration of teacher training programs.

core_concepts.title: PM eVIDYA (One Nation, One Digital Platform)
core_concepts.description:
Launched in May 2020 under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan to unify all efforts related to digital/online/on-air education.
Key Components:
1. DIKSHA: Unified as the 'One Nation, One Digital Platform' for school education.
2. One Class, One TV Channel: SWAYAM PRABHA was expanded. Dedicated DTH channels were allocated for each class from Class 1 to Class 12.
3. Shiksha Vani: Extensive use of Radio, Community Radio, and CBSE Podcasts for visually impaired students or those without screens.
4. E-Content for CWSN: Special digital content developed using DAISY (Digitally Accessible Information System) and sign language for Children with Special Needs.

core_concepts.title: The 4 Quadrants of SWAYAM (MOOC Pedagogy)
core_concepts.description:
To ensure comprehensive learning, every course on SWAYAM is structurally divided into 4 quadrants:
- Quadrant 1 (e-Tutorial): Video and audio lectures, animations, and simulations.
- Quadrant 2 (e-Content): Downloadable/printable reading material, PDFs, e-Books, and text transcripts.
- Quadrant 3 (Web Resources): Discussion forums to clarify doubts, open peer interactions, and related external links.
- Quadrant 4 (Self-Assessment): Quizzes, MCQs, short answer questions, and assignments to test learning.

core_concepts.title: NISHTHA (National Initiative for School Heads' and Teachers' Holistic Advancement)
core_concepts.description: The world's largest teacher training program of its kind. Originally launched as a face-to-face training module, it was completely digitized and integrated into the **DIKSHA** platform during the pandemic. It focuses on capacity building, shifting teachers from rote-learning methods to competency-based and joyful learning.

core_concepts.title: National Coordinators for SWAYAM
core_concepts.description:
9 National Coordinators are appointed to manage SWAYAM content:
- UGC (Post-Graduation)
- NPTEL (Engineering)
- CEC (Undergraduate education)
- NCERT & NIOS (School education)
- IGNOU (Out-of-school students)
- IIMB (Management studies), etc.

important_entities.name: DAISY (Digitally Accessible Information System)
important_entities.key_fact: Crucial standard for inclusive digital education.
important_entities.significance: Mandated under PM eVIDYA for CWSN. DAISY formats allow text to be read aloud via screen readers with high navigable precision, making digital textbooks accessible to visually impaired and dyslexic students.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: In exams, be careful with the number of SWAYAM Prabha channels. Originally there were 32, then 34. However, under the PM eVIDYA expansion specifically mentioned in budgets, it was expanded to over 200 channels to fulfill the 'One Class, One TV Channel' mandate for states to broadcast in regional languages.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: V T D A (Video, Text, Discuss, Assess)

exam_strategy_tips: If a question asks 'Which initiative provides QR coded energized textbooks?', the answer is **DIKSHA**. If it asks 'Which initiative uses Radio/Podcasts?', the answer is **Shiksha Vani** (part of PM eVIDYA).
